title: Re-spend more

predict.q: The share of extra income re-spent rises from 50% to 80%. The injection is still 100. What happens to the total rise in income?

options.s: It stays at 100, because the injection has not changed.
options.fb: The injection starts the process; re-spending adds further rounds.

options.s: It gets smaller, because people spend their money faster.
options.fb: Re-spending more means a larger share passed on each round, so the total grows.

options.s: It gets bigger, because more of each round is passed on.
options.fb: Rounds of 100, 80, 64, 51.2 … add up to 500, against 200 when half is re-spent.

options.s: It is the same, because spending only moves money around.
options.fb: Each round of spending creates new income for someone else.

task: Move the slider from 50% to 80% and watch the rounds stack up into the total.

target.do: Move the share re-spent slider to 80%, then press Check.

takeaway: The more of each round is re-spent, the bigger the multiplier.
